fields.label: Firm
fields.desc: The firm that issued the code. Rep codes are only meaningful within a firm, so every Tier 1 match filters on this field.
fields.help: The firm that issued this code.

fields.label: Active Allocation Total
fields.desc: Total allocation across assignments with no end date. A validation rule blocks it from exceeding 100. Under 100 means a team member left without a new split; processing routes those trades to review. Display and validation only: processing calculates the split in effect on each trade date.
fields.help: Should equal 100%. If it is lower, someone's share needs to be reassigned before trades can load.

fields.label: Rep Code
fields.desc: The code this assignment belongs to. Master-detail so allocations roll up to the code's Active Allocation Total.
fields.help: The dealer code this advisor shares or holds.

fields.label: Advisor
fields.desc: The advisor receiving a share of trades on this code during the effective period.
fields.help: The advisor who receives a share of this code's trades.

fields.label: Allocation Percent
fields.desc: This advisor's share of trades on the code. Active assignments on a code must total 100. Solo codes use 100.
fields.help: This advisor's share of each trade, for example 60. All advisors on the code must add up to 100.

fields.label: Effective Start Date
fields.desc: First date this advisor held the code. Tier 1 matching requires the trade date to be on or after this date.
fields.help: The date the advisor started using this code.

fields.label: Effective End Date
fields.desc: Last date this advisor is known to have held the code. Firms do not report transfers, so this is normally set by the system when a reviewer confirms a suspected reassignment, using Last Confirmed Trade Date as the boundary. Blank means no reassignment has been detected; it does not prove the code is still held by this advisor.
fields.help: The last date this advisor is known to have used this code. Usually set automatically when a code transfer is confirmed during review.

fields.label: Last Confirmed Trade Date
fields.desc: Trade date of the most recent loaded trade confirmed under this code and advisor. Updated by the load job. Used to detect dormant codes reactivating and as the inferred end-date boundary when a reassignment is confirmed.
fields.help: The most recent trade confirmed for this advisor under this code. System-maintained. Do not edit.

fields.label: End Date Source
fields.desc: How the Effective End Date was established. Lets auditors distinguish dates the system inferred from dates verified externally.
fields.help: Select how the end date was confirmed. Choose Inferred from Review if it was set from trade data alone.

fields.label: Rep Code
fields.desc: The rep code that placed the trade, as resolved by matching. Advisor credit comes from this code's assignments in effect on the Trade Date.
fields.help: The dealer code this trade was placed under.

fields.label: Fund
fields.desc: The fund traded, resolved from the raw fund name in the file through the Fund Alias table. Needed to report net sales by fund.
fields.help: The fund that was bought or sold.

fields.label: Trade Date
fields.desc: Date the trade was placed, as reported by the source firm. Determines which Rep Code Assignments (and splits) apply.
fields.help: The date the trade was placed.

fields.label: Transaction Type
fields.desc: Direction of the trade, normalized by each source firm's mapping profile regardless of whether the firm signals direction with a type column or a negative amount. Drives the sign of Signed Amount.
fields.help: Whether the fund was bought (Purchase) or sold (Redemption).

fields.label: Amount
fields.desc: Gross dollar amount of the trade, always stored as a positive number. A validation rule enforces Amount > 0, so direction lives only in Transaction Type.
fields.help: The dollar value of the trade, entered as a positive number.

fields.label: Signed Amount
fields.desc: Amount with direction applied: positive for purchases, negative for redemptions. This is the value TradeAllocator splits across advisors.
fields.help: The trade amount as it affects net sales. Redemptions show as negative.

fields.label: Trade
fields.desc: The trade being allocated. Master-detail so allocations are deleted with the trade.
fields.help: The trade this allocation belongs to.

fields.label: Advisor
fields.desc: The advisor credited with this portion of the trade. Advisor-level reporting must use this object, not the trade, to avoid double counting.
fields.help: The advisor credited with this share.

fields.label: Allocation Percent
fields.desc: Snapshot of the advisor's share on the trade date, copied at load time. Deliberately not a formula, so later split changes do not rewrite history.
fields.help: The advisor's share of this trade when it was loaded. Not updated if the team's split changes later.

fields.label: Allocated Amount
fields.desc: This advisor's share of the trade's Signed Amount, calculated by TradeAllocator at load. Negative for redemptions, so summing by advisor and fund gives cumulative net sales (the team's AUM). Allocations for a trade always sum exactly to the Signed Amount.
fields.help: The advisor's share of this trade. Redemptions appear as negative amounts.

fields.label: Normalized Key
fields.desc: Output of NameNormalizer.firmKey() for the alias. Indexed (External ID) for fast lookup. Deliberately not unique: if a key maps to more than one record, the row is sent to review instead of auto-resolving.
fields.help: System-generated matching key. Do not edit.

fields.label: Firm
fields.desc: The firm this name variant refers to. Created when a reviewer approves a new variant, so the same spelling resolves automatically next time.
fields.help: The firm this spelling refers to.

fields.label: Normalized Key
fields.desc: Output of NameNormalizer.firmKey() for the alias. Indexed (External ID) for fast lookup. Deliberately not unique: if a key maps to more than one record, the row is sent to review instead of auto-resolving.
fields.help: System-generated matching key. Do not edit.

fields.label: Fund
fields.desc: The fund this name variant refers to. Created when a reviewer approves a new variant, so the same spelling resolves automatically next time.
fields.help: The fund this spelling refers to.

fields.label: Status
fields.desc: Lifecycle stage of an import batch. Received is set by the inbound endpoint. Mapping Review means no active mapping profile matched the file's headers, or the matching profile is incomplete. Staged means every row was normalized into staging rows and the batch is ready for matching. Later values are used from phase 3. Set by Apex only.
fields.help: Shows where this import is in the process. Mapping Review and Pending Review batches are waiting on a reviewer.

fields.label: Source Firm
fields.desc: Code of the firm that sent the file, supplied by the push job (the firm's folder name in the data lake). Used to choose between mapping profiles and shown to reviewers for context.
fields.help: The external firm this trade file came from.

fields.label: Source File Name
fields.desc: Original file name from the data lake, kept for traceability between the source system and Salesforce.
fields.help: The original name of the file as it arrived from the data lake.

fields.label: File Hash
fields.desc: SHA-256 hash of the raw file contents, computed by the inbound endpoint and checked against the push job's own hash. Unique, so the same file can never be loaded twice when a job is re-run.
fields.help: System-generated fingerprint used to block duplicate imports. Do not edit.

fields.label: Mapping Profile
fields.desc: The mapping profile applied to this file. Blank while the batch is in Mapping Review because no profile matched. Recorded so every batch shows exactly which column mapping produced its staging rows.
fields.help: The saved column mapping used to read this file.

fields.label: Row Count
fields.desc: Number of non-blank data rows parsed from the file, excluding the header. Used in the reconciliation check: rows in must equal rows loaded plus rows rejected.
fields.help: How many trade rows were in the file.

fields.label: Error Row Count
fields.desc: Number of staging rows with validation errors. Rows with errors are never matched or loaded until corrected.
fields.help: How many rows in this file have problems that must be fixed.

fields.label: Error Message
fields.desc: Reason the batch failed or stopped at Mapping Review (parse error, incomplete mapping profile, unexpected exception). Shown to reviewers and included in notifications.
fields.help: Explains why this import failed or needs a mapping review, if it did.

fields.label: Import Batch
fields.desc: The batch this row belongs to. Master-detail so rows are deleted with the batch and can be counted with roll-ups.
fields.help: The import this row came from.

fields.label: Row Number
fields.desc: Position of the row among the file's non-blank data rows (1 = first data row after the header). Lets reviewers and firms trace any staging row back to the original file.
fields.help: The position of this row in the original file.

fields.label: Raw Data
fields.desc: The original row as JSON, keyed by the file's own column headers, before any mapping. Kept unchanged for audit and so a corrected mapping profile can be re-applied without re-sending the file.
fields.help: The row exactly as it appeared in the file. Do not edit.

fields.label: Source Rep Code
fields.desc: Rep code from the file after normalization: whitespace removed, upper-cased, and leading zeros removed from all-numeric codes. Input to Tier 1 matching.
fields.help: The dealer code reported in the file.

fields.label: Source Advisor Name
fields.desc: Advisor name as reported in the file, with extra spaces removed. Used for name corroboration and to detect possible rep code reassignments.
fields.help: The advisor name reported in the file, if any.

fields.label: Source Firm Name
fields.desc: Firm or branch name as reported in the file. When blank and the mapping profile is a single-firm feed, filled with the profile's firm name. Resolved to an Account through the Firm Alias table.
fields.help: The firm name reported in the file, if any.

fields.label: Source Fund Name
fields.desc: Fund name as reported in the file. Resolved to a Fund (Product2) through the Fund Alias table.
fields.help: The fund name reported in the file.

fields.label: Trade Date
fields.desc: Trade date parsed using the mapping profile's declared date format, never guessed per row. Blank if the value could not be parsed (see Validation Errors).
fields.help: The trade date, converted from the file's date format.

fields.label: Transaction Type
fields.desc: Direction of the trade, derived using the profile's direction convention: a type column (BUY/SELL, ACHAT/RACHAT and similar) or the sign of the amount.
fields.help: Whether the fund was bought or sold.

fields.label: Amount
fields.desc: Gross trade amount as a positive number, after removing currency symbols, thousands separators and any sign used to indicate direction. Rounded to 2 decimals.
fields.help: The dollar value of the trade.

fields.label: Validation Errors
fields.desc: Problems found while normalizing the row, one per line (unparseable date, missing amount, unknown transaction type, wrong number of columns). A row with errors is never matched or loaded.
fields.help: Lists anything wrong with this row that must be fixed before it can load.

fields.label: Has Errors
fields.desc: True when Validation Errors is not blank. Set by Apex. Exists because roll-up summaries cannot filter on long text fields; drives Import Batch Error Row Count.
fields.help: Checked when this row has validation errors. Set automatically.

fields.label: Source Firm
fields.desc: Firm code this profile reads files for, matching Import Batch Source Firm. Used to choose between profiles when two firms send identical layouts.
fields.help: The firm code whose files this mapping reads.

fields.label: Firm
fields.desc: The firm Account this feed belongs to. When Single Firm Feed is checked, its name fills in a missing firm on every row.
fields.help: The firm this feed belongs to.

fields.label: Header Fingerprint
fields.desc: SHA-256 of the file's normalized header row (trimmed, lower-cased, single-spaced, joined with |). Used to pick the profile automatically. External ID for fast lookup; not unique, because a Draft and an Active version can share a layout.
fields.help: System-generated identifier for the file layout. Do not edit.

fields.label: Column Map
fields.desc: JSON object mapping each source column header to a canonical field: repCode, advisorName, firmName, fundName, tradeDate, amount, transactionType, or IGNORE. Every column in the file must appear, so nothing is silently dropped.
fields.help: How each column in the file maps to a trade field. Every column must be mapped or marked IGNORE.

fields.label: Date Format
fields.desc: Date format used by this source. Declared once per profile because dates like 03/04/2026 are ambiguous row by row. A value that does not fit the format is flagged, not guessed.
fields.help: The date format this firm uses in its files.

fields.label: Decimal Separator
fields.desc: Decimal separator used in amounts. Period means 1,234.56. Comma means 1 234,56 or 1.234,56, common in French-language exports.
fields.help: Choose Comma if this firm writes amounts like 1 234,56.

fields.label: Direction Convention
fields.desc: How this source indicates buys versus sells. Type Column requires a transactionType column. Signed Amount means negative amounts are redemptions, and a transactionType column is not allowed.
fields.help: How this firm shows whether a trade is a purchase or a redemption.

fields.label: Single Firm Feed
fields.desc: When checked, the profile's Firm fills in a missing firm name on rows from this feed. Leave unchecked for aggregator feeds that contain multiple dealers.
fields.help: Check only if every row in this feed always comes from the same firm.

fields.label: Status
fields.desc: Only Active profiles are used to read files. Draft profiles are proposed mappings awaiting confirmation (phase 3). Retired profiles are kept so past batches remain explainable.
fields.help: Only Active mappings are used. Retire old mappings instead of deleting them.

vrs.name: Allocation_Cannot_Exceed_100
vrs.msg: Active allocations on this rep code total more than 100%. Reduce or end-date another advisor's share first.
vrs.desc: Blocks active assignments on a code from totalling more than 100%. Percent values evaluate as decimals in formulas (100% = 1). Totals under 100 are allowed here and caught at processing time.

vrs.name: End_Date_Before_Start
vrs.msg: Effective End Date cannot be before Effective Start Date.
vrs.desc: Prevents inverted effective windows, which would break trade-date matching.

vrs.name: Allocation_Percent_Range
vrs.msg: Allocation Percent must be greater than 0 and no more than 100.
vrs.desc: Keeps each advisor's share within a valid range.

vrs.name: Fund_Required
vrs.msg: Select the fund that was traded.
vrs.desc: Lookups to Product2 cannot be required at the field level, so this rule enforces it.

vrs.name: Fund_Required
vrs.msg: Select the fund this spelling refers to.
vrs.desc: Lookups to Product2 cannot be required at the field level, so this rule enforces it.

vrs.name: Amount_Must_Be_Positive
vrs.msg: Amount must be a positive number. Use Transaction Type to mark redemptions.
vrs.desc: Direction is stored only in Transaction Type, so Amount must always be positive.

vrs.name: Column_Map_Required_When_Active
vrs.msg: An Active mapping profile needs a Column Map.
vrs.desc: Prevents activating a profile that cannot map any columns.

vrs.name: Fingerprint_Required_When_Active
vrs.msg: An Active mapping profile needs a Header Fingerprint.
vrs.desc: Without a fingerprint the profile can never be selected.

vrs.name: Firm_Required_For_Single_Firm_Feed
vrs.msg: Select the Firm when Single Firm Feed is checked.
vrs.desc: Single-firm feeds fill missing firm names from this lookup.
